tldr: 週末彙整（市場休市）：台股週五收在46,000點附近，本週Fed決策撞上「四巫日」結算。
台積電8月營收創新高、年增53%，AI需求持續供不應求，2026年資本支出上調至600至640億美元。
壽險業9月底面臨TIS首次資本考核，金管會鬆綁過渡措施，為2026年保險業雙接軌鋪路。
台灣亞洲資產管理中心帶動業界AUM增逾10兆元，達兩年目標兩倍。

items.title_en: TAIEX holds near 46,000 into a pivotal Fed week
items.summary_zh: 歷經震盪一週，台股週五收在46,000點附近，台積電仍是盤面定海神針。市場聚焦本週重頭戲：Fed在9月15至16日利率決策撞上台股「四巫日」結算，此組合通常放大指數波動。加上季底作帳行情與9月逾2,000億元除息款回流，資金可望轉進先進封裝與矽光子（CPO）等AI供應鏈族群。投資人須留意會前觀望與結算調節交錯，短線量能與類股輪動是觀盤重點。
items.summary_en: After a volatile week, Taiwan's benchmark TAIEX ended Friday around the 46,000 level, with TSMC still the market's anchor. Traders now brace for a heavy calendar: the Fed's Sept 15–16 decision collides with a quadruple-witching expiry, a combination that typically lifts index volatility. Season-end window dressing and inflows from more than NT$200bn of September dividend payouts are expected to support funds rotating into advanced-packaging and silicon-photonics names.

items.title_zh: 先進封裝、CPO族群領軍布局
items.title_en: Advanced-packaging and CPO names lead post-SEMICON positioning
items.summary_zh: SEMICON Taiwan落幕後，資金加速卡位先進製程、先進封裝與矽光子（CPO共同封裝光學）概念股，晶圓代工、封測與光通訊供應鏈成為焦點。輝達強勁財測強化AI多頭格局，使台灣晶片供應鏈續居全球AI資本支出核心。惟Fed決策在即，投資人對高評價標的轉趨選股，族群強弱分化加劇，量能是否延續、外資態度將牽動後市多空與輪動節奏。
items.summary_en: In the wake of SEMICON Taiwan, funds have accelerated positioning in advanced-process, advanced-packaging and silicon-photonics (co-packaged optics) stocks, with foundry, packaging-and-test and optical-communication suppliers in focus. Strong NVIDIA guidance has reinforced the AI bull narrative, keeping Taiwan's chip complex central to global AI capex even as investors turn more selective on valuations ahead of the Fed.

items.title_zh: 台積電8月營收創高年增53%　AI需求供不應求
items.title_en: TSMC posts record August revenue, up 53% as AI demand outpaces supply
items.summary_zh: 台積電8月營收約新台幣5,148億元、年增53.3%，並連四月改寫單月新高，AI晶片需求持續供不應求。公司已將2026年資本支出上調至600至640億美元，並揭露美國亞利桑那州總投資達2,650億美元；同時仍向客戶示警產能無法完全滿足需求。管理層看好AI多年期循環延續至2029至2030年，凸顯先進製程與封裝擴產動能，牽動整體供應鏈拉貨與資本支出節奏。
items.summary_en: TSMC reported record August revenue of about NT$514.8bn, up 53.3% year over year and a fourth straight monthly record, as AI-chip demand continues to outstrip supply. The company has lifted its 2026 capital budget to US$60–64bn and disclosed US$265bn of total planned Arizona investment, while telling customers it still cannot fully meet demand—underscoring a multi-year AI cycle executives expect to run toward 2029–2030.

items.title_zh: 台積電設備需求近倍增　擴廠加速
items.title_en: TSMC's equipment needs nearly double as fab expansion accelerates
items.summary_zh: 台積電單季晶片製造設備需求較去年底近乎倍增，約為去年12月預估的1.9倍，反映其為AI需求加速擴充產能。此一擴張沿供應鏈外溢至半導體設備與材料廠，SEMICON Taiwan亦聚焦先進封裝、異質整合與矽光子，視為台灣半導體生態系下一波主戰場。設備、耗材與封測供應商可望受惠，惟須留意產能到位時程與人才、電力等瓶頸對擴產步調的影響。
items.summary_en: TSMC's quarterly chipmaking-tool requirements have nearly doubled since late last year—about 1.9 times the amount projected in December—as it races to expand capacity for AI. The surge ripples through the equipment and materials supply chain, with SEMICON Taiwan spotlighting advanced packaging, heterogeneous integration and silicon photonics as the next battlegrounds for Taiwan's semiconductor ecosystem.

items.title_zh: 壽險TIS首考將至　金管會鬆綁助過關
items.title_en: Life insurers face first TIS capital review as FSC eases the transition
items.summary_zh: 台灣壽險業9月底面臨新一代清償能力制度（TIS）首次資本適足性考核，依規定2026至2028年半年報TIS須於期限前申報。金管會祭出過渡措施，包括資本減壓與申報彈性，協助業者順利通過首考，在推進更嚴格清償標準的同時緩解短期資本壓力，為2026年保險業「雙接軌」鋪路。相關進度攸關金控與壽險股評價、增資與股利政策，市場密切關注過渡期效應與資本缺口變化。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's life insurers face their first capital-adequacy check under the new-generation solvency regime (TIS) by end-September, with half-year TIS filings due before the deadline through 2026–2028. The FSC has rolled out transition measures—capital relief and filing flexibility—so the industry can smoothly clear the first review, cushioning near-term capital strain while phasing in tougher solvency standards ahead of the 2026 dual-track adoption.

items.title_zh: 金管會延續阻詐與安養信託政策
items.title_en: FSC extends anti-fraud drive and senior-care trust push
items.summary_zh: 金管會持續推進消費者保護，9月1日提醒民眾勿透過未經核准在台設立據點的金融機構投資，並推動「安養信託」相關措施守護樂齡族群資產。此舉針對線上詐騙與未經許可的跨境招攬加強防堵，同時深化信託型商品，在數位金融詐欺手法日益精密之際強化消費者保護。相關措施亦牽動金融機構法遵成本與信託業務布局，提醒投資人審慎查證平台合法性與商品適配性。
items.summary_en: The FSC has continued its consumer-protection agenda, reminding the public on September 1 not to invest through financial institutions lacking approved local operations, and promoting "senior-care trust" measures to safeguard retirees' assets. The moves tighten defenses against online scams and unlicensed cross-border solicitation while deepening trust-based products, reinforcing consumer protection as digital-finance fraud grows more sophisticated.
items.source_name: 金融監督管理委員會保險局

items.title_zh: 亞資中心AUM增逾10兆元　達兩年目標兩倍
items.title_en: Asset-management hub AUM jumps over NT$10tn, doubling the two-year goal
items.summary_zh: 台灣「亞洲資產管理中心」政策自2024年9月啟動以來，帶動整體金融業資產管理規模較推動前大增逾新台幣10兆元，超過兩年增加4兆元目標的兩倍。銀行端「財管2.0」高資產業務規模倍增至2.7兆元、客戶數約2.5萬人。公股與民營銀行重兵集結高雄資產管理專區，競逐「留財引資」商機，私人銀行、家族辦公室與境外資產管理平台（OAMU）成為布局核心，牽動財管手續費收入成長。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Asian Asset Management Center initiative has driven industry-wide assets under management up more than NT$10tn since the policy launched in September 2024—over twice the NT$4tn two-year target. Bank "Wealth Management 2.0" high-net-worth business has multiplied to NT$2.7tn with about 25,000 clients, as public and private banks concentrate in the Kaohsiung asset-management zone to compete for affluent flows.

items.title_zh: 銀行押注私募市場與家族辦公室
items.title_en: Banks bet on private markets and family offices for next growth leg
items.summary_zh: 在台灣2026亞資高峰論壇，銀行業者看好私募市場與家族辦公室，呼籲擴大另類資產布局、深化跨境財管服務。除傳統股票與債券外，私募股權、金融資產融資及家族辦公室服務被視為高資產客群的重要成長動能，顯示財管模式加速轉向以顧問為導向、手續費為基礎的經營。此布局將牽動另類資產貨架、跨境法遵與理財專員專業量能，亦考驗銀行差異化與客戶資產配置能力。
items.summary_en: At Taiwan's 2026 asset-management forum, bankers voiced optimism on private markets and family offices, urging broader allocation to alternative assets and deeper cross-border wealth services. Beyond traditional equities and bonds, private equity, financial-asset financing and family-office services are seen as key growth engines for high-net-worth clients, signaling a shift toward advisory-led, fee-based wealth models targeting affluent Taiwanese.
